payload.recallText: I am a teacher of nine year olds and umm I'm a creative teacher and I make up games for them when I'm teaching them about something. Now we will be learning about the Oregon Trail. I've taught them with fun games like they got letter from a time machine.. umm I made up names like cheezy pizza and salad de caesar. It always gets the kids attention. But the Oregon Trail is serious and an important time in history with westward expansion and real risks and dangers on the trail. Ummm I make a plan to teach this that way.  A kid named Alex asks "but will it be a game". I say yes, but it will be a dangerous game and people might die on the trail. I study names of people who died on the trail and have the kids take their last names. ummm they can keep their real names but now Alex is Alex Bacon. I have them walk about 4 miles around Manhattan. I tell them a snake oil salesman is selling an elixer to get them to Oregon in 1/2 the time. The kids don't know what snake oil salesman means- a con man. All they know is it's a grown up word they don't know yet or think about like taxes. A smart alec kid asks for a drink of water at a water fountain. I say there are no water fountains on the Oregon Trail. Then I think about a parent call later and possible consequences for denying a child water. I decide to say "great! there is a fresh stream running here and let them have a drink of water.
